name: gemini
description: Google Gemini API: generateContent (non-streaming), countTokens, embeddings, models and files

nodes.title: Generate content
nodes.description: Ask Gemini (not streamed); the text is in candidates[0].content.parts[].text. Check candidates[0].finishReason and promptFeedback.blockReason (urlContext from agents only when GEMINI_TOOL_ALLOW_URL_CONTEXT=1)

model.description: Model id without the models/ prefix, e.g. gemini-2.5-flash

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
